verdict.rationale: OpenAI maintains a dedicated changelog page (developers.openai.com/api/docs/changelog) with dated entries covering new models, capability additions, API key policy changes, and deprecations, plus a standing deprecations page cross-linked from the changelog for upcoming shutdowns. This gives developers a clear, maintained trail of model and API changes to follow. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that the changelog is reliably comprehensive or timely, and no RSS/webhook-style subscription mechanism is evidenced.
